name: The Sister
description: Cordelia's younger sister. An emissary from vampire society, sent to testify at the trial and bring Cordelia home. Whether she genuinely loves her sister or has been sent as a political tool is ambiguous, perhaps both.
backstory: Still within vampire society, she represents the path Cordelia rejected. She has adapted to or accepted the ideology that Cordelia fled.
motivation: To bring Cordelia home. To fulfill whatever role vampire society has assigned her. Possibly genuine sisterly love entangled with political duty.
arc: Arrives at the Holy See and offers Cordelia an alternative cage: return to the family, to society, to belonging. Freedom from human justice, but imprisonment in vampire expectations. Forces Cordelia to articulate why she left and why she cannot return.
traits: genuinely caring or expertly performing care

relationships.Cordelia: Sister. Offers return to vampire society, which Cordelia refuses.

keyDialogue: 'You could come home. Mother would forgive you. The Elders would accept your eccentricities as a phase.' / 'And what would I be, if I returned? A daughter who learned her lesson? A vampire who remembered her place?' / 'You would be alive.' / 'I have been alive for a very long time, sister. It is not the same as living.'
